notes: Lighter while you play. Following a Steam or Epic game no longer starts PowerShell every 3 seconds: the launcher asks Windows directly whether anything changed, and PowerShell only when a new program appears, to confirm a game has closed, and for a routine check every 5 minutes (its answer still decides, as before). Pausing a game and spotting anti-cheat use the same direct list. The launcher's screens check the controller 4 times a second instead of 60 while they aren't in use.
